none

[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Sherman wheel AO issue

[u][b]WEAPONS[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Deployment animations would get stuck in some instances. (Ie. Deployed prone, moving to standing)

[u][b]CHARACTERS[/b][/u]

[u][b]OTHER[/b][/u]

[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] CN Translation for Cossack/Osttruppen

[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] RU Mk. 2 translation

[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] RU/CN translation for Milice uniforms

[u][b]MISSIONS[/b][/u]

[u][b]Campaign[/b][/u]
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Ten seconds vote timer value as option in mission parameters
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] RPT Logging for Timeline functions. [AB]
[*] [b]CHANGED:[/b] Prevent client from pausing AB timeline if the server has already finished. [AB]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Timeline Skip function now correctly waits the first client to reach the end of a skip
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Prevent timeline from progressing time during a skip event. Now waits for all clients/server to be ready
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Missing "attach explosive" action for StuH and Panther. [M4]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Missing marker reference in classic briefing. [M5]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Function execution till SPE_fnc_VoiceOver_VehicleRespawn is defined. [M5]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Dummy able units to copy loadout from were not always cleaned-up. [M5]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Dummy dog and fox units to copy loadout from were not always cleaned-up. [M5]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Missing marker reference in classic briefing. [M6]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] One could not attach explosives to all types of enemy tanks. [M6]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Faulty format index in flare logging. [M6]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Trigger inProtectedAreaWarning only for players (not AI) and only those players in the area. [M7]

[u][b]SCENARIOS[/b][/u]

[u][b]Combat Patrol[/b][/u]
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] coding - made sure "BIS_CP_detected" variable is always defined
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] BIS_CP_detected variable was not synced over net

[u][b]Escape[/b][/u]
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] Coding - handle no group selection in the menu properly
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] Coding - SPE_GroupConfigs and SPE_UnitList fallback setup
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] First group is selected by default now in the group selection menu
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Delay populating specific locations until BIS_MissionInitDone is true

[u][b]Warlords[/b][/u]
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] Re-added ability to customize available assets for both sides per scenario. Needs in description.ext or addon config.cpp a 'class CfgWLRequisitionPresets_SPE' definition as with the Vanilla Warlords setup (only extra _SPE tag in the root class) and 'SPE_WL_shoppingList[] = {"A3DefaultAll"};' to set the desired set

[u][b]Fixed[/b][/u]
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] God mode setting wasn't applied properly and thus no unlimited asset placement possible

[u][b]ARSENAL[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Undefined VRHitparts_hitdamage variable in a corner case
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] VRHitparts_hitdamage array reset was done wrong

[u][b]HUNTER SQUADS[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Hunter squads only spawned one unit per group

[u][b]CDA[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] SPE_CDA_Difficulty_Adjustment_Active was set to true by default (should be false/disabled by default) if CDA settings menu was opened

[u][b]VEHICLE CUSTOMIZATION[/b][/u]
[*] [b]CHANGED:[/b] Increased width of UI to prevent longer texts from being cut off

[u][h3]NEW FILES[/h3][/u]
none

[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Unique variable name for USAAF squadron codes
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] New squadron decal definitions to P-47

[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] French CCKW and G503 variants
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] M45 can be crewed while being towed
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Ability to set default randomisation format for vehicle numbers
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Historically correct number prefixes for US ground vehicle numbers
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Alternate wheel model for early M4 and M4A1 Shermans

[u][b]CHARACTERS[/b][/u]
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] German Rifle grenadier vests
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Camo variant of German pioneer gear
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Officer shoulder rank selection for US uniforms
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Low-blouse US uniform variants
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Cows will now Moo
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] m43 airborne uniforms with gloves configs
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Officer field US uniform variants
[*] [b]UPDATED:[/b] Improved German pioneer vest models and textures
[*] [b]UPDATED:[/b] US officer rank insignia textures

[u][b]VEHICLES[/b][/u]
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Config definitions for ViV for G503_MB variants
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Config definitions for ViV for 105mm M3 Howitzer
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Towing: added config variable to allow units to stay inside towed vehicles
[*] [b]UPDATED:[/b] Nashorn shell texture/rvmat to be more shiny
[*] [b]UPDATED:[/b] M18 and M10 shell materials to be more shiny 
[*] [b]UPDATED:[/b] M18 appearance adjusted to more closely match the Shermans
[*] [b]UPDATED:[/b] M10 appearance adjusted to more closely match the Shermans 
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] elevation indicator for artillery sights better aligned on non-16:9 aspect ratios
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] M18 model geometry on front glacis and driver side plates
[*] [b]CHANGED:[/b] Improved commander unit detection for vehicle HUD commander view cone
[*] [b]CHANGED:[/b] Improved mainTurret detection for vehicle hud so it no longer filters FFV capable turrets
[*] [b]CHANGED:[/b] Vehicle number decal system: SPE_US_Decals_Air_LettersAndNumbers variable back to 'SPE_Letters' as it was breaking backwards compatibility
[*] [b]CHANGED:[/b] M3 halftrack textures to better match tank olive colours
[*] [b]CHANGED:[/b] Sherman wheels dirt to match better with hull
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] M4 Sherman. Drivers hands no longer clip with the direct vision port on the early Sherman when turned out and the armour is hidden
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Panzer 3. Driver's feet no longer clip with the vehicle floor
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Panzer 3. Optimized shadow LOD
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Jeep. Clipping windshield decal edges
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] M8/M20 top speed corrected to 89 km/h
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] ghosting around rivets etc on the M18 and M20

[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Number/Letter decal system wasn't allowing custom input on US letters
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] AT gun pushing/towing asphalt wheel sound effects
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Typo in R200 hitpoint armorComponents
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] G503 and R200 had invalid selection names for rear wheel hitpoints
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Pilot proxy was inside P47 damageHide selection causing the camera to move inside geometry when killed
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] French M4 and M4A3 Shermans were using the incorrect vehicle number decals
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Vehicles using old SCALAR number set up would cause an onscreen error.
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Corrected damage material assignments for m4a3 stowage

[u][b]WEAPONS[/b][/u]
[*] [b]CHANGED:[/b] No.3 Mk.I strings to use roman numerals instead of Arabic numerals
[*] [b]CHANGED:[/b] Lowered M9A1 AT grenade penetration values to be more accurate to historical values
[*] [b]CHANGED:[/b] fuseDistance on all rocket ammunition to 0 meters - wasn’t working correctly till 2.20
[*] [b]CHANGED:[/b] illumination flares descent rate to match 2.20 illumination flares
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] STG44. Removed visible recoil spring
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Incremental loading on an empty magazine (like sniper rifles) would remove a bullet from a magazine
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] M1 Garand not-empty reload animation had incorrect left hand IK setup

[u][b]CHARACTERS[/b][/u]
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] CanFitUnderADoor property to rats so they can't flex their door opening abilities
[*] [b]UPDATED:[/b] M42 hiddenselections config
[*] [b]UPDATED:[/b] Improved German canvas suspenders models and textures
[*] [b]UPDATED:[/b] Bayonet selection on haversack
[*] [b]UPDATED:[/b] US wool trouser boot appearance
[*] [b]UPDATED:[/b] Added new textures for German pioneer gear
[*] [b]UPDATED:[/b] German grenadier units now use grenadier webgear
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Broken weights on m43 gloves
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Broken weights on US wool uniform officer variants
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Incorrect _as in German canvas suspenders material
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] M43 airborne uniform gloves variants rigging issues

[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] missing medic text for several uniform variants in Chinese, Russian, and Spanish localisations
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] some haversack models missing camo selections
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] us captain uniform having 1LT insignia assigned
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Broken animation when switching from unarmed to pistol
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Editing loadout on Milice units would break belt hiding function

[u][b]OBJECTS[/b][/u]
[*][b]FIXED:[/b] disabled faulty inheritance definition in SPE_building_base class

[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Dedicated strings for the marker light modules
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] SPE_System_fnc_remoteSetShotParents function to CfgRemoteExec whitelist
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Dedicated strings for the marker light modules
[*] [b]CHANGED:[/b] barrage and ordnance module no longer side chat "incoming" warning message. Can be re-enabled with 'SPE_ModuleBarrage_showRadioChatMessage/SPE_ModuleOrdnance_showRadioChatMessage = true;'
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Incorrect number of parameters for lockTurret in alterHeight static weapon function
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Artillery barrage module would create a script error if placed in the editor and made editable by Zeus

[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Empty reloads with M37 shotgun lead to duplicate magazines
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Incorrect number of parameters for lockTurret in disassemble_weapon static weapon function
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] various missing geometry lods in proxies, causing 'no geometry or visual shape' rpt error
Removed: obsolete chat logging.

[u][b]Campaign[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Missing doneKeys definition

[u][b]M7[/b][/u]
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] Reinforcements arrival hint
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] small voice over cutting problem in outro narration

[u][b]SCENARIOS[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Missing doneKeys definition

[u][b]Attack on Mortain[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Convoy script error when convoy vehicle gets deleted/removed

[u][b]Panzerkampfwagen[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] German car at spawn being underground

[u][b]Prizefighter[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Faulty crew killed voice over setup (message duplication)

[u][b]Combat Patrol[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Missing doneKeys definition

[u][b]Escape[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Missing doneKeys definition


[u][b]ARSENAL[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Weapon attachments, flashlights and other items not available when faction/side filter active

[u][b]REVIVE[/b][/u]
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] Optimized HandleDamage EventHandler

[u][b]HUNTER SQUADS[/b][/u]
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] Coding - units should not get created at [0,0,0]

[u][b]CDA[/b][/u]
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] CDA info dialog menu entry in ESC menu
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] SPE_CDA_DisableEndMissionInterruptMenuEntries variable
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] Coding - handle undefined mission parameter text

[u][b]IFS[/b][/u]
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] SPE_IFS_ReducedInvalidDurationForMissingFO variable to customize/shorten delay till next target attempt is done by mortars/heavy artillery if no FO available for any reason (per side and difficulty level) - default is 15 seconds
[*] [b]ADDED:[/b] SPE_IFS_TemporarilyInvalidTargetDuration variable to customize wait delay till next target attempt is done by mortars/heavy artillery if no FO available or the current target became invalid for any reason (per side and difficulty level) - default is 60 seconds
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] All functions to use SPE_fnc_IFS_isAACapable
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] Specific advanced hint only to be shown when the respective type is available currently
[*] [b]IMPROVED:[/b] Coding - optimized SPE_IFS_myEmergencyCallReadiness to be only sent over network when changed and reduced precision to seconds
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Automated indirect fire support calls by AI (Missing parameters from refactoring to call SPE_fnc_IFS_KnownTargetsManager directly from EH)
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Automated indirect fire support calls by AI (Missing parameter handover to SPE_fnc_IFS_KnownTargetsManager by SPE_fnc_IFS_artilleryInit)
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Missing class to AA assets detection.

[u][b]RFS[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Property naming from "SPE_CleanUp_Distances_Panicked" to "SPE_CleanUp_Distances_POW"

[u][b]ADD EXPLOSION ACTION[/b][/u]
[*] [b]FIXED:[/b] Add Explosive Action module does not display action to remote clients in multiplayer

notes.title: Arma 3 Creator DLC: Global Mobilization - Cold War Germany Update 1.6
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042220/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Global_Mobilization__Cold_War_Germany/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/89928a7f310f552c6dbe321c11a696c366c7c4d3.png[/img][/url]
 
Third-party Arma 3 developer [url=https://www.global-mobilization.com/][b]Vertexmacht[/b][/url] along with Publisher [url=https://www.bohemia.net/][b]Bohemia Interactive[/b][/url] have released a [b]sixth content update[/b] for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042220/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Global_Mobilization__Cold_War_Germany/][b]Arma 3 Creator DLC: Global Mobilization - Cold War Germany[/b][/url].  
 
[b]Update 1.6[/b] delivers new vehicles and vehicle variants, new weapons and equipment, and various fixes and improvements.
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/131fa0b00f6390692c84749fabcf61f4a938fac1.jpg[/img]
 
Update 1.6 highlights include:
 
[b]New vehicles and vehicle variants:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2B11 120mm mortar
[*] BMP-1P
[*] BRDM2 ATGM 9P133
[*] BRDM2 ATGM SF 9P133
[*] BRDM-2RS (Polish version of the BRDM-2RCH)
[*] TPz 1 VHF jammer
[*] TPz 1 Fuchs Medic
[*] RakJPz 2
[*] KPz 1A4
[*] M113A1G 120mm mortar carrier
[*] M120 120mm mortar
[*] PzBtl 293 insignia added
[*] KPz1A5DK1
[*] KPz1A5DK1 with dozer blade
[*] "Red Hornet" paint variant of Bo105 PAH
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/681eb57ce8bc908d593ddf9c475cecd982a3d45f.jpg[/img]

[b]New weapons and munitions:[/b]
[list]
[*] M/77 smoke grenade
[*] M/56 hand grenade
[*] GC Army 40x47mm ammunition
[*] DE Army 40x46mm ammunition
[*] 40 round magazines for AKM rifles
[*] SS.11 ATGM weapon (RakJPz2)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/92523df14e755356c7737993f46a5b173c8f16c2.jpg[/img]

[b]New equipment:[/b]
[list]
[*] BESPA UTV vest with variants
[*] BESPA vest with variants
[*] M86 helmet with variants
[*] UTV rig with variants
[*] UTV hat with variants
[*] UTV uniform (Strichtarn) with variants
[*] UTV uniform (Strichtarn-Green) with variants
[*] UTV rank insignia
[*] Ochra AKM vest with variants
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/4658ccc191b81577fdac56b1eab090895c40e28c.jpg[/img]

[b]New units:[/b]
[list]
[*] DDR '90 Infantry
[*] DDR '90 Motorized Infantry groups (BMP-1P, SPW-60, Truck gel. 5 Transport)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/0e44ee5b0297125e74efbe106a7140ae04a3773f.jpg[/img]

[b]New objects:[/b]
[list]
[*] 100mm ammo boxes
[*] 100mm shell models
[*] 100mm static ammo objects
[*] 105mm ammo boxes
[*] 105mm DM512 HESH-T
[*] 105mm shell models
[*] 105mm static ammo objects
[*] 122mm ammo boxes
[*] Additional 122x447mm shell models
[*] Additional ammo pallets
[*] Ammobox Type 8 (122mm, 100mm)
[*] Box pallet
[*] Fuel canister pallet
[*] Static 120mm mortar round objects
[*] Wooden ammo box Type 7 (DM1202 120mm mortar round ammo box)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/f7a4e0d03a2614aca26624ad00152316b66c9fb7.jpg[/img]

[b]New features and modules:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ability for tank commanders to override turret control (take full control of the turret)
[*] Ability to cycle between light modes, Normal Lights, Blackout Lights, IR Lights, Marker Lights, Convoy Lights (where available)
[*] Ability to toggle beacon lights via key toggle
[*] Ability to raise and lower dozer blades via key input
[*] Ability for Do-28D2 to take off doors, enables FFV door gunner position
[*] Ability for L-410T to take off doors, enables FFV door gunner position
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/c98fa9b2ce1b27c24ed2ba6c7281ca48f4f0246e.jpg[/img]

[b]Various fixes and quality-of-life improvements[/b]
 
You can find the [b]full changelog[/b] for Update 1.6 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/107410/view/521966748731179666][b]here[/b][/url]. For an in-depth introduction to the update's new content, you can read the latest [b][url=https://dev.arma3.com/post/oprep-global-mobilization-update-16]OPREP blog post[/url][/b] by developer Vertexmacht.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/52dbb7b3f7e94df63f6538a10f02af599c4cd0ae.jpg[/img]
 
The CDLC is available for purchase at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042220/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Global_Mobilization__Cold_War_Germany/][b]Steam Store[/b][/url].
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042220/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Global_Mobilization__Cold_War_Germany/
 
We hope you'll enjoy this free update and thank you for your support!
 
Bohemia Interactive & Vertexmacht
 
[i]Creator DLC is a label for original Arma 3 projects made by third-party developers and published by Bohemia Interactive. This program enables external talent to earn a financial reward for their work, while players get to enjoy more quality content. For more information, please visit the [url=https://arma3.com/dlc/creator][b]Arma 3 website[/b][/url].[/i]

notes.title: Arma 3 Mac Port Update 2.18
notes.content:
We have good news for Arma 3 [b]Mac[/b] players: [url=https://dev.arma3.com/post/spotrep-00115][b]Update 2.18[/b][/url] for the experimental client ports has been released.

[url=https://dev.arma3.com/ports][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/d17c5e4b88be5832c2587b7d05f5dbf7e76eadbd.png[/img][/url]

Our partners at [url=https://www.vpltd.com/][b]Virtual Programming[/b][/url] have ported the recent platform update, which restores cross-play multiplayer with Windows. It is now also possible to deploy the Marine Joint Task Force (MJTF) thanks to support for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647830/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Expeditionary_Forces/][b]Expeditionary Forces[/b][/url] Expeditionary Forces Creator DLC by [url=https://tinygeckostudios.com/][b]Tiny Gecko Studios[/b][/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647830/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Expeditionary_Forces/

As a reminder: the game's Launcher is not available on Mac. Please refer to the [url=https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Arma_3:_Play_on_Mac][b]Community Wiki guide[/b][/url] on how to load optional (Creator) DLC and mods.

Visit [url=https://dev.arma3.com/ports]https://dev.arma3.com/ports[/url] for all details.

notes.title: Mac Port 2.16 Technical Statement - Reaction Forces and Western Sahara
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/a113a74d5f4e22b6e999a8eec5e000c8dbb49b9f.png[/img]

[h2]🚨 Attention Arma 3 players on Mac 🚨[/h2]

We will be rolling back the Mac versions of our Reaction Forces and Western Sahara Creator DLCs.

The current versions of the CDLCs have had high crash rates due to a mismatch of the base game data, and we believe rolling them back will provide a better experience for our Mac players.

However, this means Mac players will not be able to play on multiplayer servers until the latest Mac Port update (2.18) is released. This update is taking longer than expected, but we will get it out as soon as it is ready.

You can however still opt into the Mac 2.18 Release Candidate testing branch via access code: [b]Arma3Update218MacRC[/b]

That RC build contains the latest version of both Creator DLC, but it is not yet ready for full release.

We understand this is not ideal, and we apologize for the temporary inconvenience.

notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647830/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Expeditionary_Forces][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/d4e302ced9950e1d8aaad9539ae35fa7dc5b0382.jpg[/img][/url]
 
Publisher [b][url=https://www.bohemia.net/]Bohemia Interactive[/url][/b] and third-party developer [b][url=https://tinygeckostudios.com/]Tiny Gecko Studios[/url][/b] are proud to release [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647830/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Expeditionary_Forces]Arma 3 Creator DLC: Expeditionary Forces[/url][/b]. You can watch the [url=https://youtu.be/OMbL-p7n9uQ][b]release trailer[/b][/url] below:

https://youtu.be/OMbL-p7n9uQ

Explore new warfare capabilities with Arma 3 Creator DLC: Expeditionary Forces. Prepare your Marines for action on the Amphibious Warfare Ship, assault enemy shores with AAV-9 Mack IFVs and Combat Boats, bring supplies ashore with the LCC-1 Landing Craft, perform raids behind enemy lines with new Hunter Reconnaissance Vehicles, and take part in the invasion of Altis from a new perspective.
 
Arma 3 Creator DLC: Expeditionary Forces is available now on [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647830/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Expeditionary_Forces]Steam[/url][/b] for $7.99 USD (€7.99EUR / £6.99 GBP).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/6eca0119a9be8e989f683c52ab3b1165bbd627f3.jpg[/img]
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647830/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Expeditionary_Forces
 
[b]Key features[/b] of the Expeditionary Forces CDLC:

[list]
[*]New faction - The Marine Joint Task Force (MJTF)
[*]AAV-9 Mack
[*]Combat Boat
[*]LCC-1 Landing Craft
[*]Amphibious Warfare Ship “USS Takmyr” (LPD-36)
[*]Hunter Reconnaissance Vehicles
[*]New vehicle munition types
[*]Resolute Cyclone SP mini-campaign
[*]Rope In Hand MP co-op scenario
[*]Various additional content
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/fac38ace5f80a931200ac8186e82f8b067b74d1b.jpg[/img]
 
Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647830/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Expeditionary_Forces][b]CDLC's store page[/b][/url] for a full overview of the content.
 
To keep track of all the latest Arma 3 news, be sure to follow the game on [url=https://www.facebook.com/armaplatform][b]Facebook[/b][/url], [url=https://X.com/armaplatform][b]X[/b][/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ArmaPlatform][b]YouTube[/b][/url], and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/107410][b]Steam[/b][/url].
 
See you in-game!
 
[i]Bohemia Interactive & Tiny Gecko Studios[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/8e79bbb233ecb9e96c88243f317a832d30c1bf09.jpg[/img]
 
[h3]Frequently Asked Questions[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]What is Arma 3 Creator DLC?[/b]
Creator DLC is a label for original Arma 3 projects made by third-party developers and published by Bohemia Interactive. This program enables external talent to earn a financial reward for their work, while players get to enjoy more new quality content. For more information, please visit the [b][url=https://arma3.com/dlc/creator]Arma 3 website[/url][/b].
[*][b]Why is Creator DLC optional to install?[/b]
We have decided to make it optional to have the Creator DLC data installed. This is mainly to avoid regular Arma 3 installations from requiring a lot more additional hard-drive storage, even for those who have not purchased a Creator DLC. Additionally, a Creator DLC's theme or setting might be very different from regular Arma 3 or not everyone might want it to be visible in their game.
[*][b]How do I launch Expeditionary Forces?[/b]
You will need to visit the DLC section in the Arma 3 Launcher, make sure Expeditionary Forces is owned and loaded, then launch the game by clicking the PLAY button.
[*][b]Can I still play together with people who do not own the DLC in multiplayer?[/b]
To enable non-owners to still play on multiplayer servers that make use of Expeditionary Forces content, Tiny Gecko Studios has published a "compatibility data for non-owners" via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3348605126][b]Steam Workshop[/b][/url]. Be aware that access to the DLC's premium mini-campaign and multiplayer scenario remain exclusive to owners of the DLC. Restrictions to the use of non-owned content also apply.
[/list]

notes.title: Arma 3 Creator DLC: Expeditionary Forces is coming soon
notes.content:
Publisher [b][url=https://www.bohemia.net/]Bohemia Interactive[/url][/b] and third-party developer [b][url=https://tinygeckostudios.com/]Tiny Gecko Studios[/url][/b] are excited to announce [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647830/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Expeditionary_Forces]Arma 3 Creator DLC: Expeditionary Forces[/url][/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647830/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Expeditionary_Forces

Explore new warfare capabilities in Arma 3 with the upcoming Expeditionary Forces Creator DLC. Prepare your Marines for action on the Amphibious Warfare Ship, assault enemy shores with AAV-9 Mack IFVs and Combat Boats, bring supplies ashore with the LCC-1 Landing Craft, perform raids behind enemy lines with new Hunter reconnaissance vehicles, and take part in the invasion of Altis from a new perspective.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/5705fce2d64afda47347728631cd13b72366632c.png[/img]
 
Key Features:
[list]
[*][b]AAV-9 Mack[/b] - The AAV-9 Mack is an amphibious Infantry Fighting Vehicle capable of ferrying a squad of 13 Marines from ship to shore at high speed. It is equipped with either a 30mm or 50mm autocannon and a 7.62mm coaxial machine gun. It features an extendable periscope for the commander and hatches in the back to allow troops to turn out and return fire.
[*][b]Combat Boat[/b] - The Combat Boat is a 17 meter long multi-role vessel. Its high speed, combined with a versatile design, makes it suitable for amphibious assaults, maritime patrol, and fire support. It can carry a squad of 16 troops plus crew, and can be fitted with a variety of weapons.
[*][b]LCC-1 Landing Craft[/b] - The LCC-1 is a landing craft used to ferry equipment and vehicles from ship to shore. Its design allows it to change between a slow-speed shallow draft ship and a high-speed catamaran. It has a maximum payload of 200 tons and is capable of reaching speeds up to 35 knots (or 65 kph).
[*][b]Amphibious Warfare Ship “USS Takmyr” (LPD-36)[/b] - The Amphibious Warfare Ship is the core of Marine Expeditionary Units. Acting as a floating barracks, it allows MJTFs to deploy all the assets required to sustain operations abroad. Named after the Takistani capital following one of Operation Arrowhead’s fiercest battles, the LPD-36 USS Takmyr is the ship assigned to carry the 29th MEU to Altis and execute Operation Resolute Cyclone. Its design features a flight deck with hangar for launching helicopters, and a well deck to launch landing crafts or amphibious assault vehicles.
[*][b]One New Faction[/b] - The Marine Joint Task Force has arrived. It is a self-contained expeditionary unit capable of operating independently from amphibious warfare ships and specialized in fighting in littoral areas. It comes with a variety of new equipment, including helmets, vests, uniforms, night vision devices, and scuba diving gear.
[*][b]Hunter Reconnaissance Vehicles[/b] - Taking advantage of the capable MRAP chassis, the Hunter Reconnaissance Vehicles greatly expand on their firepower and sensors. Three new variants are available: Fire Support Vehicle (featuring a 30mm rapid-fire autocannon and Titan missiles), Anti-Tank (featuring a dual Titan-NLOS launcher and 7.62mm coaxial machine gun), and Low Altitude Air Defense (featuring a 30mm rapid fire autocannon, SAAMI missiles, and short-range radar for drone detection).
[*][b]AH-99J Python[/b] - At the request of the Marines, an upgrade for the AH-99 was developed in the late 2010s. Named AH-99J Python, the helicopter trades some of its stealth capabilities for long-range datalink antennas, more powerful radar, and external stores allowing it to carry a wider array of weapons, including AGM-122M Sidearm anti-radiation missiles and Titan NLOS pods.
[*][b]Resolute Cyclone SP Mini-Campaign[/b] - On the eve of the NATO invasion on Altis, Marines from the 29th MEU are tasked with securing the western part of the island. Join the MJTF in this single player mini-campaign, use stealth to infiltrate enemy territory, cut the enemy off from reinforcements, and liberate Kavala from the AAF.
[*][b]Rope In Hand MP CO-OP[/b] - A platoon from Light Armor Reconnaissance is tasked with clearing the road for the Marines who are rapidly advancing towards Athira. Hop in a Hunter FSV or Hunter AT with your friends in this multiplayer co-op scenario and strike deep into enemy territory.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/ee023d54d6fcea899a349e3ea7dfe0b351234860.png[/img]

New Features:
[list]
[*][b]Airburst Munitions:[/b] The Hunter LAAD's autocannon is loaded with Airburst munitions which, when combined with radar targeting information, can easily destroy fast aircraft or small drones with just a few shots.
[*][b]Enhanced Drone Detection:[/b] The Hunter LAAD features radar that trades detection range for higher sensitivity, enabling it to even detect small quadcopter drones up to a distance of 4 kms. 
[*][b]Titan NLOS:[/b] Long-range anti-tank missile that requires a datalink to gather targeting information, and can engage both laser and vehicle targets. Using ground following radar, it can fly past terrain obstacles and engage targets with no line of sight at launch up to 32 kms away. 
[*][b]AGM-122M Sidearm:[/b] The AGM-122M Sidearm was developed as a cheap alternative to more expensive and sophisticated AGM-88C HARM anti-radiation missiles. Converted from stocks of Falchion-22 short range air-to-air missiles, the Sidearm takes advantage of already existing mounts to give most western-made aircraft basic SEAD/DEAD capabilities. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/5d27b10263c59f0e459d73ef4530f3a4f6ed0df9.png[/img]
 
[i]Arma 3 Creator DLC: Expeditionary Forces[/i] is scheduled for release [b]soon[/b] and will be priced at [b]$7.99 USD[/b] (€7.99 EUR / £6.99 GBP). To be notified of the release of [i]Expeditionary Forces[/i], you can add the CDLC to your Steam wishlist via the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647830/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Expeditionary_Forces]store page[/url][/b].
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/a13456c9e1f4b93ce3bdad988d277150322197f3.png[/img]
 
In addition, on the day of the full release of the CDLC, Tiny Gecko Studios will publish a [b]compatibility data pack for non-owners[/b] to the Arma 3 Steam Workshop. Subscribing to this Workshop item will allow those who do not own [i]Expeditionary Forces[/i] to still play on multiplayer servers that use the assets from the CDLC. Restrictions on in-game use of CDLC assets by non-owners also apply. More information can be found on the [b][url=https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Arma_3:_DLC_Restrictions]Community Wiki[/url][/b].
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/582f3de29524989a328cdb70db9e60577f14a256.png[/img]
 
[b]Creator DLC[/b] is a label for original Arma 3 projects [b]made by third-party developers[/b] and [b]published by Bohemia Interactive[/b]. This program enables external talent to earn a financial reward for their work, while players get to enjoy more new quality content. So far, six other Creator DLC projects have been released: [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042220/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Global_Mobilization__Cold_War_Germany/]Global Mobilization - Cold War Germany[/url][/b] (April 2019), [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227700/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_SOG_Prairie_Fire/]S.O.G. Prairie Fire[/url][/b] (May 2021), [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294440/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_CSLA_Iron_Curtain/]CSLA Iron Curtain[/url][/b] (June 2021), [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1681170/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Western_Sahara/]Western Sahara[/url][/b] (November 2021), [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175380/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Spearhead_1944/]Spearhead 1944[/url][/b] (July 2023), and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2647760/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Reaction_Forces/]Reaction Forces[/url][/b] (March 2024).
 
To learn more about the Arma 3 Creator DLC initiative, and to find answers to some of the most Frequently Asked Questions, please visit [b][url=https://arma3.com/dlc/creator]https://arma3.com/dlc/creator[/url][/b]. For all the latest Arma 3 news, be sure to like our official [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/armaplatform]Facebook Page[/url][/b], follow our [b][url=https://x.com/armaplatform]X account[/url][/b], subscribe to the [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/@ArmaPlatform]Arma Platform YouTube Channel[/url][/b], and join the Arma 3 [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/107410]Steam Community[/url][/b].

Together with third-party developer [b][url=https://spearhead-1944.com/#about]Heavy Ordnance Works[/url][/b], we are excited to announce today's release of a major update to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175380/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Spearhead_1944]Arma 3 Creator DLC: Spearhead 1944[/url][/b]!

[*][b]A New Helicopter, Pickup Truck, UAV, and Two Static Mortar Systems[/b] - Run water bombing or Search and Rescue missions with the new Cougar Helicopter, cross rough terrain in the versatile MOOSE pickup, or support combat efforts with the new RC-40 Micro-UAV, Commando Mortar, and 120 mm Twin Mortar system.
[*][b]New Pylon Weapons Systems[/b] - Outfit your helicopter with formidable firepower with the 12.7 mm autocannon, 20 mm cannon DAR/DAGR x19 missiles, or Tratnyr HE/AP x16 missiles.
[*][b]New Uniforms and Equipment[/b] - Rapidly respond to situations with the right gear, available in multiple variants - including new wildland firefighter fatigues, flight helmets and suits, heavy combat helmets, shape breaker covers for existing helmets, full brim hard hats, duffle bags, TNVG-B night-vision goggles, Carrier Lite Rig and Tactical Vest Rig variants, and colored steerable parachutes.

As a Quick Reaction Force (QRF), defend against waves of enemies and fight for your life against overwhelming odds in this new co-op game mode. Conserve your ammo and pick your targets carefully while working closely with a team of up to six people.

notes.title: Arma 3 Creator DLC: Spearhead 1944 is coming soon
notes.content:
Publisher [b]Bohemia Interactive[/b] and third-party developer [b]Heavy Ordnance Works[/b] are thrilled to announce a major new [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175380][i]Arma 3 Creator DLC: Spearhead 1944[/i][/url][/b].  

[previewyoutube=syxwHjFqbhs;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175380

In this new Creator DLC, you will be a part of the US First Army’s advance as they attempt to break through the German lines. Take advantage of an array of US weaponry and equipment and traverse the fields and bocage of an all new Normandy terrain. [i]Spearhead 1944[/i] will offer a seven mission multiplayer co-op campaign, several official scenarios and game modes, and even more content creation opportunities with the [i]Arma 3[/i] scenario editor. Players will be introduced to the lesser known Operation Cobra - taking place 7 weeks after D-Day, with the US First Army attempting to break through the German lines around Saint-Lô. The Creator DLC will deliver an immersive and historic military sandbox experience on a scale not seen before in [i]Arma 3[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/2c2a27dbed394f2b754c59b5c5788d8aa2cfac7d.jpg[/img]

Key features of the [i]Spearhead 1944 Creator DLC[/i] include:
[list]
[*][b]Normandy Terrain[/b] - Explore 150 km² of unique terrain, based on real locations and topography of North-West France. An immersive environment to play the campaign and run missions. The terrain features flowing rivers, an airstrip, the destroyed city of Saint-Lô, wooded areas, fields with traditional French bocages and much more. Featuring new and unique buildings, ruins, objects and plants as well as dug in positions and light fortifications. Over 400 street signs aid players in navigating the vast road network. Explore the overgrown, well defended landscape of Normandy, where every field is another potential bloody battle.
[*][b]5 Playable Factions and Civilians[/b] - Featuring elements of the US Army, Free French, and German Forces equipped with their own uniforms and gear.
[*][b]50+ Weapons and Grenades[/b] - Engage the enemy with detailed recreations of 1944 weaponry and a diverse arsenal of grenades and explosives.
[*][b]40+ Vehicles & Static Weapons[/b] - Wage war in a range of transports and armored vehicles, such as the M18 Hellcat, M10 Wolverine, and Tiger I. You'll also be supported by a number of static weapons including trench variants, searchlight, and mortars.
[*][b]Uniforms and Other Gear[/b] - Equip yourself with more than 200 uniform variants, 60+ vest variants, 70+ backpack variants, and 150+ headgear variants alongside a bunch of accessories.
[*][b]Multiplayer Co-op Campaign[/b] - Seven co-op missions, fully voiced and highly replayable for up to 24 players, inspired by the real events of Operation Cobra, revealing the significance to liberated Europe and covering key milestones such as the liberation of Saint Gilles and the defense of Saint Denis-le-Gast
[*][b]6 Multiplayer Scenarios[/b] - Play six new scenarios in Arma 3's official Combat Patrol, Escape, Warlords and Zeus game modes with various upgrades, additions, faction selection and automatic support for WW2 mods.
[*][b]Singleplayer/Co-op Scenario: Der Zahnarzt[/b] - Members of the French Resistance were ordered by the SOE to eliminate Standartenführer Konrad Dentist Hoffmann at the occupied Château near Marigny.
[*][b]US Faction Showcase[/b] - Become familiar with the Allied arsenal and help push through Normandy during Operation Cobra.
[*][b]German Faction Showcase[/b] - Build defenses and assist the retreating forces.
[*][b]Sounds & Effects[/b] - Experience immersive audio designed to accurately reproduce the sounds of a World War 2 battlefield: Incoming projectiles, shell ricochets and interior hit sounds, plane fly-by sounds, bullet cracks, explosions, call-in radio requests and the desperation of surrendering soldiers, cries of the wounded and the dying.
[*][b]Music[/b] - A custom and atmospheric soundtrack, specifically selected to transport you to 1944.
[*][b]Additional Content[/b] - Custom systems to increase immersion (i.e. ambient war sounds, illumination flares, ordnance and artillery barrage, custom HUD for vehicles), to expand gameplay and tactical options (i.e. enhanced revive, indirect fire support, surrendering, bolt action rifles, extended reload animations, bayonets, open bolt hipfire, wall avoidance, realistic tank penetration, deflection and destruction), AI behavior (i.e. revive for AI, targeting and weapons management in tanks by AI a gunner/commander, custom difficulty adjustment system) and more. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/a21ecb09c92c8319705b4249c05606531ae14c48.jpg[/img]

The [i]Arma 3 Creator DLC: Spearhead 1944[/i] is scheduled for release [b]later this year[/b] and will be priced at [b]$17.99 USD[/b] (€17.99EUR / £14.99 GBP). The precise release date will be shared at a later time. To be notified of [i]Spearhead 1944's[/i] release, you can also add the CDLC to your Steam wishlist via the store page. More information about the project can also be found at [url=https://www.spearhead-1944.com]www.spearhead-1944.com[/url]. Heavy Ordnance Work plans to share more development insights via their social media accounts on [url=https://www.facebook.com/HeavyOrdnanceWorks]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/HeavyOrdWorks]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@heavyordnance_works]YouTube[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/111bb26601c231acde2652d677a5cd27b537351d.jpg[/img]

In addition, on the day of the full release of the CDLC, Heavy Ordnance Works will publish a [b]compatibility data pack for non-owners[/b] to the Arma 3 Steam Workshop. Subscribing to this Workshop item will allow those who do not own [i]Spearhead 1944[/i] to still play on multiplayer servers that use the assets from the CDLC. It will also allow people to view the new Normandy terrain in Eden Editor in camera mode and inspect the assets in the Arsenal in-game before purchasing. However, playing on the CDLC's premium Normandy terrain and access to the campaign and mission scenarios will remain exclusive to the owners of the [i]Spearhead 1944[/i] CDLC. Restrictions on in-game use of CDLC assets by non-owners also apply. More information can be found on the [url=https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Arma_3:_DLC_Restrictions]Community Wiki[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/83e96fe468d5fcdef9ebd1e2418aab3e672cd4e9.jpg[/img]

Prairie Fire[/i][/url] (May 2021), [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294440/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_CSLA_Iron_Curtain/][i]CSLA Iron Curtain[/i][/url] (June 2021), and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1681170/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Western_Sahara/][i]Western Sahara[/i][/url] (November 2021).

To learn more about the [i]Arma 3[/i] Creator DLC initiative, and to find answers to some of the most Frequently Asked Questions, please visit [url=https://arma3.com/dlc/creator]arma3.com/dlc/creator[/url]. For all the latest [i]Arma 3[/i] news, be sure to like our official [url=https://www.facebook.com/armaplatform]Facebook Page[/url], follow our [url=https://twitter.com/armaplatform]Twitter account[/url], subscribe to the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ArmaPlatform]Arma Platform YouTube Channel[/url], and join the Arma 3 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/107410]Steam Community[/url].

notes.title: Arma 3 Mac Port Update 2.12
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the experimental client port for Mac has been updated to [b][url=https://dev.arma3.com/post/spotrep-00109]Arma 3 2.12[/url][/b]. This new version now supports both [b]Apple silicon (M1/M2) and Intel chips[/b], offering cross-play compatibility with Windows and support for the [b]full range of DLC[/b].

notes.title: Global Mobilization CDLC Update 1.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/3a7af96a32503dd2d3e11a1ca8f26356f553b12b.jpg[/img]

Hello there!

Third-party Arma 3 developer [url=https://twitter.com/globmob_arma3][b][i]Vertexmacht[/i][/b][/url] has released the [b]fifth major content update[/b] for their Creator DLC: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042220/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Global_Mobilization__Cold_War_Germany/]Global Mobilization - Cold War Germany[/url].  

With Global Mobilization very soon marking its 4th anniversary, Update 1.5 offers a new co-op multiplayer scenario, more "Force Recon" multiplayer game mode, 4 new vehicles, 15+ weapons, and much more.

https://youtu.be/YfNlOoFBj2I  

All vehicles are now more refined, with more intricate details and improved appearances. Certain sounds have been revamped, many new vehicle customization options have been made available, and new variants have been introduced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/f512843452f043e2a8d3f646efe6a4577fdf7e9d.jpg[/img]

A new Revolutionary faction has been introduced and with it comes a series of new equipment and weapons to arm them, including scopes, uniforms, vests, suppressors and more.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/2101cf9cb7a5bf2bce8b094d0e12da99e81da2f9.png[/img]

Players can now team up to play a completely new game mode: Force Recon. In this you'll be sent behind enemy lines to try to gather intel about enemy forces without being noticed. You’ll need to accurately triangulate positions, take photographs and regularly contact HQ by radio to submit your intel.  

https://youtu.be/9QHx2f02FEk  

Update 1.5 highlights include:

[b]4 new vehicles/vehicle variants[/b]
[list][i][*] SPW-60PA (DShKM)
[*] SPW-40P2 (Ch)
[*] Typ 2 Van
[*] W123[/i][/list]
[b]Additional highlights[/b]
[list][i]
[*] 15+ new weapons and weapon variants
[*] New Revolutionary Faction 
[*] New co-op multiplayer scenario: "Red Steel"
[*] New "Force Recon" MP game mode
[*] All-new scopes, uniforms, vests, headgear, suppressors, gadgets, and more
[*] Furniture objects and integrated a module that automatically furnishes all houses[/i]
[/list][b]Various fixes and quality-of-life improvements[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/e7198372222077f52268fa52b9991c40021423d1.jpg[/img]

You can find the [b]full changelog[/b] for Update 1.5 on the [url=https://forums.bohemia.net/forums/topic/223833-global-mobilization-changelog/?tab=comments#comment-3474524]Bohemia forums[/url] and learn more about the new vehicles by reading the latest [b][url=https://dev.arma3.com/post/oprep-global-mobilization-update-15]OPREP blog post[/url][/b] by developer Vertexmacht.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/e46c9d23bddb4782cf085b9e091185a309a700fc.jpg[/img]

This is the fifth major content update since the Global Mobilization DLC’s initial release and marks the perfect time to get it if you haven’t already. The DLC is available for purchase at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042220/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Global_Mobilization__Cold_War_Germany/]Steam Store[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042220/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Global_Mobilization__Cold_War_Germany/

We hope you'll enjoy this free update and thank you for your support!

Bohemia Interactive & Vertexmacht

[previewyoutube=IF7RMHM_jrU;full][/previewyoutube]

[*]MG42 7.92mm Machine Gun with 2 variants

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/db040e69b479d552498b70a3573766fcd802376b.png[/img]

[*]F1 Submachine Gun and bayonet

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/0d36177273ec7138c01d26324908ba0c0a97a8aa.png[/img]

notes.title: Arma 3 Creator DLC: Western Sahara is out now
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1681170/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Western_Sahara/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/decbaf6ea168ae5a5491bea69318f96ae59e4f65.png[/img][/url]
 
Together with third-party developer [b]Rotators Collective[/b], we're announcing today the release of the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1681170/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Western_Sahara/]Arma 3 Creator DLC: Western Sahara[/url][/b]. The new content is presented in a [b][url=https://youtu.be/bVdGJ5P4Peg]trailer[/url][/b].
 
https://youtu.be/bVdGJ5P4Peg
Set in the year 2036, Western Sahara takes you to Sefrou-Ramal – a province in the fictional country of Argana. This region has been a hotbed of conflict for many years due to rival tribes, underfunded peacekeeping forces, and a foreign military presence. Here, you will be able to choose from several official singleplayer and/or multiplayer scenarios. This includes the open-world scenario "Extraction", which brings back the "ION Services" private military company faction from Arma 2 for a combat search and rescue mission. The DLC also provides new weapons, vehicle variants, clothing, and gear.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/0974e3a0dd1f9077171f60ed9c7245972099d505.jpg[/img]
 
The Western Sahara DLC is now available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1681170/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Western_Sahara/]Steam[/url] for [b]$6.99 USD[/b] (€6.99 EUR / £5.99 GBP). If you purchase the DLC within the first week of its release (before November 25), you will receive a [b]15% launch discount[/b] (price with discount applied: $5.94 USD / €5.94 EUR / £5.09 GBP). The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/107410/Arma_3/]Arma 3 base game[/url] is currently on sale at 75% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1681170/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Western_Sahara/
 
Key features of the Western Sahara DLC:
[list]
[*]100 km2 Sefrou-Ramal terrain
[*]Armed forces: ION Services, SFIA, Tura, UNA, NATO Desert
[*]4 weapons & 1 static weapon
[*]9 vehicle variants
[*]Gun drone, portable ballistic shield, various masks
[*]Open-world scenario: "Extraction" (singleplayer and co-op multiplayer)
[*]Multiplayer mode: "King of the Dunes" (competitive multiplayer)
[*]Multiplayer mode: "Last Stand" (co-op multiplayer)
[*]Showcase: "ION Weapon Systems" (singleplayer scenario)
[*]2 time trial races (singleplayer challenges)
[*]Various additional content
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/a2c591b38927318ffc3f4b8d038be1118735541f.jpg[/img]

Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1681170/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Western_Sahara/]DLC's store page[/url] for a full overview of the content.
 
To keep track of all the latest Arma 3 news, be sure to follow the game on [url=https://www.facebook.com/arma3official]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/arma3official]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/Arma3official]YouTube[/url], and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/107410]Steam[/url].
 
See you in-game!

[i]Bohemia Interactive & Rotators Collective[/i]
 
 
[h3]Frequently Asked Questions[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]What is Arma 3 Creator DLC?[/b]
Creator DLC is a label for original Arma 3 projects made by third-party developers and published by Bohemia Interactive. This program enables external talent to earn a financial reward for their work, while players get to enjoy more new quality content. For more information, please visit the [url=https://arma3.com/dlc/creator]Arma 3 website[/url].
[*][b]Why is Creator DLC optional to install?[/b]
We have decided to make it optional to have the Creator DLC data installed. This is mainly to avoid regular Arma 3 installations from requiring a lot more additional hard-drive storage, even for those who have not purchased a Creator DLC. Additionally, a Creator DLC's theme or setting might be very different from regular Arma 3 or not everyone might want it to be visible in their game.
[*][b]How do I launch Western Sahara?[/b]
You will need to visit the DLC section in the Arma 3 Launcher, make sure Western Sahara is owned and loaded, then launch the game by clicking the PLAY button.
[*][b]Can I still play together with people who do not own the DLC in multiplayer?[/b]
To enable non-owners to still play on multiplayer servers that make use of Western Sahara content, Rotators Collective has published a "compatibility data for non-owners" via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2636962953]Steam Workshop[/url]. Be aware that access to the DLC's premium Sefrou-Ramal terrain and scenarios remain exclusive to owners of the DLC. Restrictions to the use of non-owned content also apply.
[/list]

Third-party Arma 3 developer Savage Game Design today released a [b]major content update[/b] today for the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227700/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_SOG_Prairie_Fire/]Arma 3 Creator DLC: S.O.G. Prairie Fire[/url][/b].

Update 1.1 adds a free new 225 km2 terrain, US Navy SEALs, multiple new vehicles, static weapons, weapons, helmets, and more.

To celebrate the new release, S.O.G. Prairie Fire will be [b]discounted by 20%[/b] for a limited time on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227700/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_SOG_Prairie_Fire/]Steam[/url].
 
[previewyoutube=ML0cFF9_Q8c;full]https://youtu.be/ML0cFF9_Q8c[/previewyoutube]

[h3]Update highlights[/h3]
 
[b]New terrain: "Khe Sanh"[/b]
This unique new terrain, covering 225 km2, enables you to design and run missions around Quang Tri Province, including some crucially contested locations of the Vietnam War.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/a0f4925700e6a82115e61774f331c3261cbf55a6.jpg[/img]
 
[b]New faction expansion: US Navy SEALs[/b]
Play as one of the three primary SEAL groups that operated in Vietnam: MACV-SOG Naval Advisory Detachment, SEAL Teams, and US Navy Underwater Demolitions Teams. The Navy SEAL faction consists of 51 preset soldier loadouts, making use of 9 new uniforms (plus 22 variants), 7 vests, and a diving mask.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/40e534835fe5fbce7d33f1201e654698449d34f4.jpg[/img]
 
[b]5 new vehicles/vehicle variants[/b]
[list]
[*]4 civilian cars: Bonn, Rodina, Kupe, and Krabice (Van). The Krabice van also comes in a variant with a mounted DP-27 machine gun.
[*]The M151 Military Utility Tactical Truck received an additional variant that carries a BGM-71 TOW missile launcher.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/c340c2895d249638c41eebf67b57c2c0aa5e23c6.jpg[/img]

[b]4 new static weapons (incl. heavy naval guns)[/b]
[list]
[*]V11M Twin 37mm cannon (PAVN)
[*]Type 56 75mm Recoilless Rifle (PAVN)
[*]L/60 Mk3 40mm cannon (US Navy)
[*]L/70 Mk2 20mm cannon (US Navy)
[/list]
[b]9 new weapons/weapon variants[/b]
[list]
[*]M63a Light Machine Gun
[*]M63a Commando
[*]MPU 9mm Submachine Gun
[*]Mk1 Underwater Defense Gun
[*]M1928A1 Tommy Submachine Gun
[*]M1A1 Tommy Submachine Gun
[*]M1A1 Tommy Shorty
[*]M1928 Tommy Submachine Gun
[*]Škorpion vz. 61 Machine Pistol
[*]Bonus: the XM177 / XM148 model has been completely replaced with a period correct handguard.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/130539d83c454cb580850a4c5c95d731a38a5538.jpg[/img]
 
[b]5 new helmets (plus variants)[/b]
To provide more variation within and between factions, you can now also equip soldiers with netted pith helmets, the M56 and SSh40 helmets for PAVN and VC forces, and netted M1 helmets for ARVN soldiers.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/b3bf4c9062279492223360dabe5cc9691724fbf2.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Additional multiplayer scenarios[/b]
The "Mike Force" co-op multiplayer game mode is available to play on Khe Sanh (requires Steam Workshop item); plus there are 4 new Zeus multiplayer scenarios for this new terrain.
 
[b]Campaign progress saving[/b]
Along with many other improvements, progress saving has been added to the Co-op Campaign while playing in multiplayer solo mode and when playing the singleplayer missions “Temporary Duty” and “The Village.”
 
[b]Various fixes and quality-of-life improvements[/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/d8827487c97b0ee8e3a009897505647bbb6287a6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Arma 3 latest Global Mobilization update adds heavy duty artillery and nukes
notes.content:
In the US Army, the infantry branch is known as the 'Queen of Battle.' It's somewhat less well-known that there's a king, and that crown belongs to artillery. So it's a shame we get to see so little of it in modern war sandbox games. Fortunately, a new content update for Arma 3's Global Mobilization DLC has added a whole lot of it, including the massive M109 Paladin.

This is the fourth content update for the Global Mobilization - Cold War Germany DLC since it launched more than two years ago. The latest update adds a total of eight new vehicles. There's the M109 self-propelled howitzer (don't call it a 'tank'!) and the M109G variant used by the West German armed forces. Players also get the Soviet 2S1 Gvozdika (another self-propelled howitzer), the SF2 LARS 2 and BM-21 Grad multiple-launch rocket systems, and the Russian 2P16 short-range ballistic missile launcher, complete with the 2K6 Luna (which can carry a nuclear warhead).

Another neat piece of military kit that comes with the latest update is the BrPz 1 'Biber' combat support vehicle. This is an easy vehicle to identify, because it has a massive, folded up bridge on top of it, which it can deploy over gaps and streams in order to create crossings for ungainly tanks and howitzers.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Arma 3 Creator DLC: CSLA Iron Curtain is out now
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294440/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_CSLA_Iron_Curtain/?utm_source=a3-steam-announcement&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=a3-csla-launch][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/191da526ac8df857437fed24a7adb39d6aaa5209.png[/img][/url]

In collaboration with third-party developer CSLA Studio, we are proud to release the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294440/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_CSLA_Iron_Curtain/?utm_source=a3-steam-announcement&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=a3-csla-launch][i][b]Arma 3[/b][/i] [b]Creator DLC: [i]CSLA Iron Curtain[/i][/b][/url] today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294440/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_CSLA_Iron_Curtain/?utm_source=a3-steam-announcement&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=a3-csla-launch

The DLC is available for purchase on Steam for $12.99 USD / €12.99 EUR / £10.99 GBP, and early adopters will receive a 10% discount in the first week of its release.

[previewyoutube=gXYmSlkTDZk;full][/previewyoutube]

Key features include:
[list]
[*] [b]256 km2 terrain[/b] - Original landlocked map called "Gabreta" with deep forests, windswept mountains, calm valleys, a railway network, and various military outposts.
[*] [b]3 factions[/b] - Cold War era armed forces of the United States and Czechoslovakia, as well as local rebel fighters.
[*] [b]35 weapons[/b] (incl. variants) - A mix of classic pistols, rifles, and launchers (with a large variety of weapon attachments), including the FAL and Sa-58 assault rifles, XM177 carbine, and M1911 pistol.
[*] [b]52 vehicles[/b] (incl. variants) - Various ground, air, and water vehicles such as the T-72 Main Battle Tank, M113 and OT-62 APCs, and Mi-17 and UH-60 transport helicopters.
[*] [b]19 scenarios[/b] - 9 singleplayer scenarios depicting various armed confrontations in the Gabreta region, 1 singleplayer Showcase scenario, and 9 multiplayer scenarios (Zeus, Warlords, co-op, team deathmatch, and more).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/060f1c8d69ba9433f0a09c787e0544cef02e8116.jpg[/img]

In the [i]CSLA Iron Curtain[/i] Creator DLC, players are taken back to the Cold War era of the 1980's, and explore what life in Czechoslovakia and its heavily-guarded border with the Federal Republic of Germany could have been like if an armed conflict had ever come between the East and the West.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/1a8d94f35b5343c5586a0078c71ccc74b60c2cc2.jpg[/img]

CSLA Studio has published a '[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2503886780][b]compatibility data pack for non-owners[/b][/url]' via the Steam Workshop, which enables those who do not own the [i]CSLA Iron Curtain[/i] DLC to still play on multiplayer servers that make use of its content. However, the DLC's terrain and singleplayer scenarios remain exclusive to owners of the DLC. Restrictions to the use of non-owned content also apply.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/99fbe5f9c5a0c7bd7516334fefe65f1ba1dee0f7.jpg[/img]

CSLA (or ČSLA) is an abbreviation for "Československá lidová armáda" in Czech and "Československá ľudová armáda" in Slovak. It refers to the Czechoslovak People's Army, which were the armed forces of the Czechoslovak Socialist Republic from 1954 until 1990.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/929b1c983cfc8ac90e7f9a41e5c725603a81b0b2.jpg[/img]

Developer CSLA Studio will share further development news and updates via their [url=http://csla-studio.blogspot.com/]website[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/cslastudio]Twitter[/url] account, and [url=https://www.facebook.com/cslastudio/]Facebook[/url] page. More information about the Arma 3 Creator DLC program can be found on [url=https://arma3.com/dlc/creator]Creator DLC website[/url].

notes.title: Arma 3 Update 2.00
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/adb99d762e3188513c67c258b2f740c18ffef8eb.png[/img]

Seven years after the official release of version 1.00 and dozens of updates later, we've now gradually reached Arma 3 version 2.00 ([url=https://youtu.be/ElxZ8ePBLPs]watch trailer[/url]). This latest update adds a free new firing drill, as well as a new color edition of an existing firearm, a camo variant for selected gear, extra Steam achievements, and the option to share compositions made in Arma 3’s scenario editor via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=107410]Steam Workshop[/url].
 
https://youtu.be/ElxZ8ePBLPs
The new firing drill (Course of Fire: Gray) invites you to set a record time on a challenging course hosted by a familiar operative from Arma 3's story campaigns. A gold medal is awarded to those who can complete the drill in under two minutes (2:00). Players running the course might encounter various surprises related to previous versions of Arma 3 if they know where to look and what to do.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/ff38d960809c5d2c8c658c5519800caa89ec8111.png[/img]
 
Players can now share custom compositions from the game directly to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=107410]Steam Workshop[/url]. They can do so by accessing Arma 3’s extensive library of weapons, vehicles, equipment, characters, structures, and props available and arranging their in-game assets in the editor. When they’re done, all they need to do is save their selected assets as a custom composition and click on the appropriate icon to publish it to the Steam Workshop. Compositions can include anything from full-blown military camps to specific roadblocks or checkpoints, a Halloween pumpkin festival, a simple table and chairs, or anything in between. By sharing their unique compositions via the Steam Workshop, Arma 3 content creators can help each other build expansive, detailed, and atmospheric scenarios quickly and easily. Further documentation can be found on Bohemia Interactive's [url=https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Eden_Editor:_Custom_Composition]Community Wiki[/url].
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/9f22e6b119e067c060cbbdf1b784de2bf5c76f86.jpg[/img]
 
But wait, there’s more! The 2.00 update also includes a new arid variant of existing CTRG special forces gear (stealth uniform and combat helmet - available for owners of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/395180/Arma_3_Apex/]Arma 3 Apex[/url] expansion) and a black variant for the P07 pistol - both of which are used in the new firing drill. Players can also unlock three new '2.00' themed Steam achievements. And finally, everyone receives a lifetime’s virtual supply of [url=https://youtu.be/-R7q2XsGIgs]"Arma" Eau de Combat[/url], which is now available as an in-game glass perfume bottle prop.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/d44da5808dd19f291a8146ef68486c2bd45e0d5f.jpg[/img]
 
The complete [b]changelog[/b] for update 2.00 can be found on the [url=https://dev.arma3.com/post/spotrep-00095]Arma 3 website[/url].
 
If you have yet to pick up the game, or simply wish to complete your DLC collection, you can get the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/107410/Arma_3/]Arma 3 base game[/url] and all of its [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/107410/]downloadable content (DLC)[/url] at [b]up to 75% off[/b] on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10866/Arma_3_DLC_Essentials/]Steam[/url]. Those who purchase the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11256/Arma_3_Ultimate_Edition/]Arma 3 Ultimate Edition[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10666/Arma_3_Apex_Edition/]Apex Edition[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11065/Arma_3_Contact_Edition/]Contact Edition[/url], or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/10866/Arma_3_DLC_Essentials/]DLC Essentials[/url] will receive an additional bundle discount on top. This special offer is available from today up until [b]Monday October 19[/b] (starting and ending at [b]10:00 PDT/19:00 CEST[/b]).

notes.title: Arma 3 Creator DLC: CSLA Iron Curtain is coming soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/32f21a0048ffebca22f3a70d15d0fb0429a93acb.png[/img]

Together with third-party developer CSLA Studio, we're excited to announce the upcoming release of Arma 3's second Creator DLC: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294440/][b]CSLA Iron Curtain[/b][/url]. Scheduled for release later this year, the CSLA Iron Curtain downloadable content pack will take players back to an alternate version of the Cold War in 1980s Czechoslovakia. The [url]store page[/url] for the upcoming DLC is already live on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294440/]Steam[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294440/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/6bc9299e4275f39a59bc6f972f659a5189506900.jpg[/img]
 
CSLA (or ČSLA) stands for "Československá lidová armáda" in Czech and "Československá ľudová armáda" in Slovak, which refers to the Czechoslovak People's Army. These were the armed forces of the Communist Party of Czechoslovakia and the Czechoslovak Socialist Republic from 1954 until 1990. With both Bohemia Interactive and the CSLA Studio developers coming from the Czech Republic, this particular Creator DLC stays very close to home by exploring the country's contemporary history and taking a look at what life in Czechoslovakia and its heavily-guarded border with West Germany during the 1980s could have been like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/060f1c8d69ba9433f0a09c787e0544cef02e8116.jpg[/img]
 
[b]The Arma 3 Creator DLC: CSLA Iron Curtain will include:[/b]
[list]
[*]Original 256 km2 "Gabreta" landlocked terrain, with deep forests, windy mountains, and calm valleys
[*]Cold War-era armed forces of the United States and Czechoslovakia, as well as local rebel fighters
[*]Ground and air vehicles
[*]Weapons and gear
[*]Singleplayer and multiplayer scenarios[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/99fbe5f9c5a0c7bd7516334fefe65f1ba1dee0f7.jpg[/img]
 
Creator DLC is a label for original new Arma 3 projects made by third-party developers and published by Bohemia Interactive. It enables external talent to earn a financial reward for their work, while players get to enjoy more new quality content. The first Creator DLC, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042220/Arma_3_Creator_DLC_Global_Mobilization__Cold_War_Germany/]Global Mobilization - Cold War Germany[/url], has managed to achieve over 50,000 sales since its launch in April 2019. More Creator DLC projects besides Global Mobilization - Cold War Germany and CSLA Iron Curtain are currently in development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/1a8d94f35b5343c5586a0078c71ccc74b60c2cc2.jpg[/img]
 
In response to community feedback on the initial release of the first Arma 3 Creator DLC, Bohemia Interactive – in close co-operation with CSLA Studio – have decided to host a small-scale, closed beta test in the coming weeks ahead of CSLA Iron Curtain's planned full release. Starting today, selected members of the Arma 3 community will be invited to help report on any remaining technical issues as well as take the upcoming DLC for a test drive on a wider variety of PC systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/929b1c983cfc8ac90e7f9a41e5c725603a81b0b2.jpg[/img]
 
Furthermore, as soon as the CSLA Iron Curtain DLC releases, Bohemia Interactive and CSLA Studio plan to make compatibility data for non-owners of the DLC available via the Arma 3 Steam Workshop – similar to how this is now also done for the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1776428269]Global Mobilization - Cold War Germany[/url] Creator DLC. This solution enables people who own the Creator DLC and those who do not to still play together on multiplayer servers that make use of the Creator DLC's assets. Access to DLC terrains and singleplayer content will remain exclusive to the owners of the DLC, and restrictions to the in-game use of DLC assets by non-owners apply.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/67eff8f481a450ce50d5ded6296a5056ae3926e2.jpg[/img]
 
The release date and pricing of the Arma 3 Creator DLC: CSLA Iron Curtain will be shared at a later time. For more information about Arma 3 Creator DLC, please visit https://arma3.com/dlc/creator.

Srdečné pozdravy!

notes.title: Arma 3 Apex: Old Man is now available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/32bf4e40b5f9ccaf49437ea9adc3b780c4f9bae9.jpg[/img]

[i]“La mission est sacrée, tu l’exécutes jusqu’au bout et si besoin, en opérations, au péril de ta vie.”[/i] – The Legionnaire’s Code of Honor, Art. 6.

Bienvenue! Today we're officially releasing the [b]Arma 3 Apex: Old Man[/b] open-world singleplayer scenario. This new scenario is free for everyone who owns the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/395180/Arma_3_Apex/]Arma 3 Apex expansion[/url]. In support of the release, Arma 3 and all of its downloadable content will also be on [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/107410/Arma_3/]sale[/url][/b] with discounts of up to 70% between April 14-21.

https://youtu.be/AkffiFKrozM

[h3]How to play Arma 3 Apex: Old Man?[/h3]
If you already own Arma 3 and the Arma 3 Apex expansion, you just need to download the latest Arma 3 update (1.98) on Steam. Afterwards, launch the game, go to SINGLEPLAYER in the main menu, click on SCENARIOS, and select [i]Old Man[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/32d1e9b14edf79f4547df24d8d7b3b4f20674f4a.jpg[/img]

In Arma 3 Apex: Old Man, you assume the role of a retired Legionnaire living on the South Pacific island of Tanoa. When a new strain of malaria causes yet another humanitarian crisis, and local authorities fail to distribute an effective vaccine to the civilian population, you're tipped off about a possible plot. Together with a former military contact, you attempt to avert a catastrophic power play in the region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/48349725ffe9e013eed65de99cda2546d717eeb7.jpg[/img]

The new scenario drops you into Tanoa’s 100 square kilometer tropical terrain with just a few instructions. It’s up to you to find your way around, gather intel, obtain weapons and equipment, and decide on the best tactics to accomplish objectives. While the scenario aims to offer an authentic experience, you do have access to a few convenience features, such as the option to wait and skip time, and the ability to fast travel between known safe houses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/f83999dcad99ad85a74a49ce65b83a47bb72b168.jpg[/img]

Arma 3 Apex: Old Man provides more than 10 hours of playtime. It's released together with a free platform update for Arma 3 (1.98). This update adds new static machine gun variants and several other assets to the game, and implements various fixes and improvements. The full changelog for update 1.98 can be found on the [url=https://dev.arma3.com/post/spotrep-00093]Arma 3 website[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2799889/ff58a3af58ef863778f59c71fd81f68ab6a4bf11.jpg[/img]

The beta version of the Arma 3 Apex: Old Man scenario was originally released in December last year via the Arma 3 Steam Workshop. If you helped playtest the beta version, we recommend to unsubscribe from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1938939381]Steam Workshop item[/url] and restart the scenario to avoid compatibility issues.

Good luck out there!

notes.title: Arma 3 Warlords Update is live
notes.content:
[h1]Arma 3 Warlords Update is live[/h1]
[i]Large-scale competitive multiplayer mode, ADR-97 Weapon Pack, and more[/i]
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2799889/64d95eb945a5828627c8194653ed90849dc4f1d9.jpg[/img]
 
Today we've released a free update for Arma 3, which introduces a new [b]competitive multiplayer mode[/b] called [b]“Warlords”[/b]. A [url=https://youtu.be/yACvGPlHejU][b]trailer video[/b][/url] explains the mode’s basic concept in the form of a military briefing.
 
https://youtu.be/yACvGPlHejU
In Warlords, there are two competing teams, and their [b]goal is to capture the base of the opposite side[/b]. Players start the match by joining either the NATO or CSAT faction. Both teams then need to start conquering sectors across the map, belonging to non-player AI forces from the AAF faction. By establishing a chain of linked sectors, opponents can plan a route from their own base to their enemy's base. Once they reach their destination, they can stage an assault against the opposing side’s base to win the game.
 
During the match, players can also earn [b]Command Points[/b]. The better an individual's performance on the battlefield and the more sectors held by their team, the greater number of points they will have available to them. These can be used to request airdrops with additional vehicles, special weapons, superior gear, friendly AI reinforcements, or strategic advantages such as fast travel and sector scans.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2799889/3222683cf26dea6370c6c9814cdf3ad592a6b861.png[/img]
 
Besides the Warlords multiplayer mode, Update 1.86 also incorporates the [b]ADR-97 weapon pack[/b] (which originally served as an [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=669962280]official showcase mod[/url]) directly into the base game. That means players, but also content creators and server hosts, can make use of this family of weapons without needing to be subscribed to the mod on the Steam Workshop.
 
Furthermore, the update adds characters to the game with [b]special heads[/b] modeled after five prominent Arma developers. These are the result of an R&D project to test Bohemia’s new photogrammetry rig and the related workflow. This system should help to make the process of texturing faces and modeling head shapes more detailed and efficient for Bohemia's future games.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2799889/d1b0db4b115ad39500c83209af6dd74bb705b108.png[/img]
 
The 1.86 platform update, also referred to as the Warlords Update, is now available for free for everyone who owns Arma 3. The complete [url=https://dev.arma3.com/post/spotrep-00082][b]changelog[/b][/url] can be found on the Arma 3 website. For those who want to learn more about our plans for Arma 3 in the next year(s), be sure to check out the recently posted [url=https://arma3.com/news/arma-3-roadmap-2018-november-update][b]Roadmap 2018 Update devblog[/b][/url].
 
Good luck out there - may the best team win!

notes.title: Arma 3 Encore Update now live
notes.content:
[h1]Arma 3 Encore Update now live[/h1]
[i]Destroyer ship "USS Liberty", SAM systems, radar sites, and more[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2799889/e486c40c74f064c247f124cfedf158d87b52ef62.png[/img]

The Encore Update is ready for boarding! Download the latest Arma 3 platform update (1.84) on Steam, and enjoy free new bonus content such as the "USS Liberty" destroyer ship, SAM systems, radar sites, anti-radiation missiles, small diameter bombs, plus various other additions and improvements.

https://youtu.be/QBYuJYjCEC0
The highlights of the Encore Update include:
[list]
[*][b]"USS Liberty" Destroyer Ship[/b] - The NATO carrier strike group has a new addition; a destroyer-class ship with detailed interiors and new naval fire-support options. It's also capable of launching/recovering small naval vessels and helicopters. The USS Liberty is a static object that can be placed and moved around the map via the in-game Scenario Editor.
[*][b]"MIM-145 Defender" SAM System & "AN/MPQ-105" Radar System[/b] - A stationary missile system used by NATO forces that presents a beyond-visual-range threat to even the most modern of aircraft. It can make use of the Data Link connection via the AN/MPQ-106 radar system.
[*][b]"S-750 Rhea" SAM System & "R-750 Cronus" Radar System[/b] - The CSAT faction's variant of a stationary long-range surface-to-air missile (SAM) system capable of engaging aerial targets from beyond-visual-range. It works in tandem with the R-750 Cronus radar system connected via the Data Link.
[*][b]Anti-Radiation Missiles & Small Diameter Guided Bomb[/b] - Both NATO and CSAT receive new anti-radiation missiles, which are designed to auto-lock on ground targets that have their active radar sensor switched on. NATO fighter jets can also be equipped with new, relatively small, air-to-surface precision-guided bombs.
[/list]
The new bonus assets were created by third-party developer BRAVO ZERO ONE Studios to celebrate the 1-year anniversary of Arma 3 Jets DLC. They are designed to provide even more opportunities for diverse and immersive military operations, while introducing more balanced options for ground-to-air combat and vice versa.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2799889/e5c55d10c2c5db8443bbf94c86784b36e46e8784.png[/img]

Besides the new sandbox content, version 1.84 also implements various adjustments to all of the official Arma 3 scenarios and campaigns released so far. These improvements are aimed at making sure that even the older playable content makes optimal use of the assets and gameplay features that were introduced to the game over the past few years.

The full update [b]changelog[/b] is available for inspection on the [url=https://dev.arma3.com/post/spotrep-00081]Arma 3 Dev Hub[/url].

See you in-game!

notes.title: Arma 3 Tanks DLC is out now
notes.content:
[h1]Arma 3 Tanks DLC is out now[/h1]
[i]New armored vehicles, mini-campaign, showcase scenario, major free platform update[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2799889/569e2367e18672d4640ab114e59c947906610612.png[/img]

Roll in heavy firepower and take control of the battlefield: [b]Arma 3 Tanks DLC[/b] is now available! Watch the [url=https://youtu.be/Hzi6f_RWJ3Y]trailer[/url] to get yourself in the mood, and prepare to knock, rock, 'n roll.

https://youtu.be/Hzi6f_RWJ3Y
Arma 3 Tanks DLC deploys [b]3 new armored vehicles[/b]: the T-140 Angara, AWC Nyx, and the Rhino MGS. Each comes in several variants and with multiple liveries. The new singleplayer [b]mini-campaign[/b] ("Altis Requiem") and [b]showcase scenario[/b] ("Tank Destroyers") provide a perfect introduction to these war machines. You'll find that there's nothing more exhilarating than driving such heavy metal bunkers and punching large holes in enemy armor. Stay on the move, and unleash fury. This is war.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2799889/c0aafab05eeb397cd59db761e03907b28c5de8b7.png[/img]

Tanks DLC is accompanied by a [b]major platform update (1.82)[/b]. This update is now available as an automatic download on Steam, and is completely [b]free[/b] for everyone who plays Arma 3. Its highlights include various enhancements to the experience of operating an armored vehicle (including 3D-modeled interiors for ALL armored vehicles in Arma 3), new targeting features, a new competitive multiplayer mode, extra time trial challenges, free new anti-tank weapons, additional vehicle variants, and more. For a complete overview of the new content and features, head over to https://arma3.com/dlc/tanks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2799889/5ddcfe68710bed5d687aad9fe5f11d577ed1c91c.png[/img]
